prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
Asset type: one medieval RPG dialogue HEAD portrait designed for 74 x 100 logical pixels.
Input 1 is the historical identity reference ONLY. Inputs 2-5 are Mara, Ivo, Leiya and Tor coarse pixel portrait STYLE references ONLY, never identities or expressions. Substantively REDRAW this person into a large mature adult face portrait, not a crop/upscale of the old full-body picture.
Composition: vertical 74:100 ratio. Large face fills most of height, visible skull top at about 3%, chin at about 88%, extremely short barely visible neck. Only a narrow bottom 6-8% clothing collar, no shoulders, chest, bust or torso. Three-quarter face toward viewer left. Keep all hair and ears entirely inside the canvas, at least 3 logical pixels top and 2 pixels each side; do not crop them to fit. Compact hair mass; face bone planes occupy more area than hair. The braid or bun must remain contained beside the head rather than extending outside.
Match the references' coarse hard-edged low-resolution pixel clusters: broad connected planes across cheekbone, nose bridge, nose wings, brow socket, jaw and chin. Intentional stepped outlines. Draw as if on a 74x100 logical pixel grid even if output raster is larger. At most 32 muted working colors, skin has 4-6 large flat tones. Hair only 3-5 broad asymmetrical masses, no fine parallel strand stripes. Eyes small and dark with narrow subdued tan-gray sclera slivers, no bright white rectangles or glossy catchlights. Strong angular adult nose and cheek structure without elderly wrinkles. No gradients, soft antialiasing, dithering, noise, grain, microtexture, anime/chibi eyes or doll face. Not a smooth painting with pixelated filter.
One person on genuine transparent background. No text, border, props, hands, limbs, shoulder spread, scenery or effects. This generated pixel-style drawing will undergo disclosed nearest-neighbor scaling, binary-alpha and no-dither palette derivation, not be represented as native authored pixel art.
Character: VERE / 维芮 / MAE-NPC-VERE. A thin woman in her THIRTIES, keeper of her own old robe and memories, self-directed, not a helpless victim. Preserve the selected reference's warm dark chestnut-brown loose swept hair and low loose braid at viewer right, a small orange-brown hair tie if visible, warm light-tan skin, slender mature face, modest straight nose and slightly pointed firm chin. Her head is not a teen's or doll's; make cheekbones and nasal ridge readable as broad blocks. Keep the ear and the few broad side curls within the canvas.
Expression: contained watchful dignity; quiet wary sideways attention to viewer left; lips CLOSED in a level restrained line with a tiny natural asymmetry. Brows mostly low and level, one slightly more intent, NOT both inner brows raised into a sad worried peak, not rage or pleading. No smile, no tearful rescue pose.
Current card overrides the old full-body blue dress at the neckline: show ONLY a narrow worn cool gray repurposed academy-robe jacket collar with muted blue-gray shadow and a tiny off-white plain inner edge. No luxurious trim, family crest, numbered mark, insignia or presented plum robe. Do not infer noble ancestry from clothing. No complete family history, sale, rescue or reconciliation outcome is depicted.
